title: GamesPlayerLeftPayload
description: games.player.left v1 (OpenVibe.Games apps/server/src/platform/gameEvents.ts playerLeftEvent, via GameEventRecorder.recordLeave from game/gameServer.ts onDisconnect -> savePlayer(session, true)). A character's connection closed: written in the same transaction as its final save, after any games.skill.leveled / games.blueprint.unlocked that save produced. session_seconds is the time since its games.player.joined in this process, rounded to whole seconds; 0 when the join was not tracked. No position, appearance, inventory, rank or connection data. Envelope: subject { type: player, id: <player.id> }, visibility subject when the player has a Network subject and internal otherwise, priority low, actor user:<usr_...> or guest:<gst_...> from player.subject, else service:games. No consumer yet.

player.description: The character. account network: a signed-in openvibe.network account, keyed by its canonical subject (user usr_..., or guest gst_... for a Network guest session). account guest: a local guest (browser token), or a Network sign-in whose token predates subject ids; no subject then.

id.description: Games character id (packages/shared/src/ids.ts newPlayerId: 10 time + 10 random characters, lowercase Crockford base32). Also the envelope subject id.

slot.description: Character slot under the account (0-2; a local guest only has slot 0).

name.description: Character name from the client hello (1-24 characters); not unique.
